meta.title: Our Team — PubliX Group
meta.description: Meet the team behind PubliX Group — the operators, founders and board members building the growth platform for SaaS companies in public services.
meta.og_image_alt: PubliX Group — Nordic public-sector SaaS growth platform

hero.title: The people behind PubliX
hero.sub: PubliX is built by operators who have founded, scaled and run software companies. When you talk to us, you talk to someone who understands your world.

mgmt.name: Alexander Hübel
mgmt.bio: Alexander has spent over 15 years building and scaling software companies. Before joining PubliX Group, he held leadership roles across SaaS, digital transformation, and M&A. He leads the group's strategy, acquisitions, and founder relationships.

mgmt.name: Marcus Åström
mgmt.bio: Marcus brings deep experience in M&A and corporate finance, with a focus on technology companies. He leads the deal process from first conversation to close, ensuring every transaction is structured fairly and transparently.

mgmt.name: Erik Runsten
mgmt.bio: Erik oversees the group's financial operations and reporting. With a background in finance and operations across technology companies, he ensures our portfolio companies have the financial infrastructure to scale.

mgmt.name: Patrick Zeits
mgmt.bio: Patrick leads the technical strategy across the group, including AI capabilities, shared infrastructure, and software architecture. He works hands-on with every portfolio company's development team.

board.name: Patrik Sallner
board.bio: Patrik is an experienced technology executive and board professional. As Chairman of the Board, he provides strategic guidance and governance oversight to the group.

board.name: Viktor Wrede
board.bio: Viktor brings investment and technology expertise to the board as an independent external director. He contributes to PubliX's strategic direction and portfolio company development.

board.name: Anders Barklöf
board.bio: Anders represents Aspira Partners on the PubliX Group board. He brings deep experience in building and scaling Nordic technology companies.

board.name: Anton Holm
board.bio: Anton represents Aspira Partners on the PubliX Group board. He contributes investment expertise and supports the group's acquisition and growth strategy.

board.name: Janne Salmi
board.bio: Janne co-founded Koivu Solutions and serves on the PubliX Group board as an entrepreneur representative. He brings firsthand experience in scaling Finnish healthcare technology into new Nordic markets.

board.name: Alexander Törnqvist
board.bio: Alexander co-founded digiPlant and serves on the PubliX Group board as an entrepreneur representative. He brings hands-on SaaS founder experience and deep knowledge of grant management technology.

founders.name: Adam Hjort
founders.bio: Adam leads Tidvis, whose platform runs the daily operations of Swedish personal assistance and LSS providers. His understanding of care workers' everyday reality drives the platform's design and development.

founders.name: Alexander Törnqvist
founders.bio: Alexander co-founded digiPlant to modernise how foundations and grant providers handle applications. Since joining PubliX, his team has continued to build out SBS Manager.

founders.name: Harri Tanner
founders.bio: Harri leads Aspicore, whose Apuraha4 platform manages the full grant lifecycle for Finnish foundations, universities and public authorities — built on two decades of work with grant systems.

founders.name: Janne Salmi
founders.bio: Janne co-founded Koivu Solutions and built Sotender, the platform that connects Finnish healthcare workers with open shifts and reduces reliance on staffing agencies.

founders.name: Johan Rydberg
founders.bio: Johan leads Embrace Safety, helping municipalities and police authorities run knowledge-based crime prevention and safety promotion work.

founders.name: Robert G. Filtenborg
founders.bio: Robert leads Bleau, whose platforms moliri and NemBolig carry public-sector and social housing communication in Denmark. He reinvested alongside PubliX and continues to run the company.

tt.title: Join us
tt.card_text: We're always looking for talented people who want to build software that matters.

pc.title: Or join one of our portfolio companies
pc.sub: Each company runs its own hiring. Reach out directly to learn about opportunities.

cta.title: Thinking about your next chapter?
cta.sub: Whether you're exploring your options, curious about where your company stands, or just want to talk to someone who understands your market — we'd welcome the conversation.
